about: Vectors for vaults.md draft 7.14 (after red team 34) (genesis_id is the id of auth.genesis). Generated by vectors/gen.mjs; every value below follows from the inputs. Ids, keys and vers are raw bytes inside hashes and HKDF info (§2). Plaintexts are canonical JSON (RFC 8785), as written here.
checks: gen.mjs first reproduces BIP-340 vector 0 and the first NIP-44 v2 conversation-key and encrypt vectors.

owner_secret.id_rule: hex(TH("nostr-vault/gen/1", V ‖ prev raw bytes or empty))[0:32]

second.preimage: V2 ‖ the first id as 16 raw bytes

owner_device.note: device certs carry no mk or ksig since 7.14

negative.name: put whose ver does not hash
keyring payload d differs from the d tag
keyring seal opened with the to-self conversation key instead of the eph one
commit signed by a key other than its dvk
commit signed over the bare id, not TH
commit whose prev breaks the chain
negative.expect: a gap: never applied as seq 2

negative.name: commit kid differs from its head epoch
head with content altered after signing
head signed correctly but sealed under another epoch
negative.expect: does not decrypt under its d: ignore

negative.name: wrap whose kid is not the hash of its key
nv1 part with a flipped byte
nv1 blob truncated: last chunk sealed with flag 0
negative.expect: GCM fails with the last-chunk nonce: refuse

negative.name: sub-cert whose storage_sig signs another dvk
CONTRIB signed by a key that is not the sub-cert dvk
removed reader repeats leave
negative.expect: no effect: ρ stays epochs.reader_removed.rho (the remove its prev names comes before it, whatever the ids)

keyring.note: opened with nip44_decrypt(eph, ct) as the owner npub; payload.d must equal the event d tag

nv1_two_parts.plaintext: byte i is i mod 251, 70000 bytes
